name: Exp_i-BandsPrice
summary: This EA trades Bollinger Bands price crossovers using a custom i-BandsPrice indicator that applies additional smoothing. It opens buy positions when the indicator value crosses down below level 4 and sell positions when it crosses up above level 0, with configurable exit signals based on threshold levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义i-BandsPrice指标进行布林带价格交叉交易，对布林带信号进行了额外平滑处理。当指标值从4下穿时开多仓，从0上穿时开空仓，并通过阈值水平配置出场信号。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于布林带均值回归原理，使用自定义i-BandsPrice指标将布林带位置转换为离散状态值（0-4），其中4代表上轨上方极度超买区域，0代表下轨下方极度超卖区域。入场条件为：当指标值从4下穿时产生买入信号（价格从超买区回落），当指标值从0上穿时产生卖出信号（价格从超卖区反弹）。出场条件为：买入平仓信号在指标值小于2时触发，卖出平仓信号在指标值大于1时触发，这是基于均值回归逻辑的提前出场机制。仓位管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，支持多种保证金模式（余额、净值、自由保证金、固定手数）。资金管理使用TradeAlgorithms库的标准化开仓函数，包含止损和止盈设置，默认止损1000点、止盈2000点。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on Bollinger Bands mean reversion, using the custom i-BandsPrice indicator which converts Bollinger Band position into discrete state values (0-4), where 4 represents extreme overbought territory above the upper band and 0 represents extreme oversold territory below the lower band. Entry conditions are: a buy signal is generated when the indicator value crosses down from 4 (price retreating from overbought zone), and a sell signal is generated when the indicator value crosses up from 0 (price bouncing from oversold zone). Exit conditions are: buy close signal triggers when indicator value drops below 2, and sell close signal triggers when indicator value rises above 1, representing an early exit mechanism based on mean reversion logic. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter which adjusts risk proportion, supporting multiple margin modes including balance, equity, free margin, and fixed lot. Money management uses the standardized TradeAlgorithms library opening functions with configurable stop loss and take profit, defaulting to 1000 points SL and 2000 points TP.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio controlling lot risk percentage

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式（余额/净值/自由保证金/固定手数）
parameters.description_en: Lot mode: free margin/balance/deducted margin/deducted balance/fixed lot

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，基于布林带均值回归原理，有明确的进出场条件
支持多种平滑算法和价格类型，灵活度高，可适应不同市场环境
具备独立的开仓和平仓信号控制开关，交易逻辑模块化设计良好
使用新K线检测机制避免重复信号，减少过度交易风险
包含止损和止盈设置，有基本的风险控制框架
pros_en: Clear strategy logic based on Bollinger Bands mean reversion with well-defined entry and exit conditions
Supports multiple smoothing algorithms and price types, offering high flexibility to adapt to different market conditions
Independent toggle switches for opening and closing signals, providing modular trading logic design
Uses new bar detection mechanism to prevent duplicate signals and reduce overtrading risk
Includes stop loss and take profit settings with a basic risk control framework
cons: 指标状态值离散化（0-4）可能丢失价格动量的精细信息，导致信号滞后
默认止损1000点和止盈2000点比例不合理，止盈过远可能导致实际难以达到
缺乏点差过滤和交易时间过滤，在高位差或低流动性时段可能产生不利成交
信号逻辑完全依赖单一自定义指标，缺乏多维度确认，容易产生虚假信号
仓位管理参数MM=0.1含义不够直观，容易误操作导致过大仓位
cons_en: Discretization of indicator state values (0-4) may lose granular momentum information, causing signal lag
Default SL 1000 and TP 2000 points ratio is questionable; TP may be too distant to achieve in practice
Lacks spread filter and trading session filter, potentially resulting in unfavorable fills during high spread or low liquidity periods
Signal logic relies entirely on a single custom indicator without multi-dimensional confirmation, prone to false signals
MM parameter value of 0.1 is not intuitive and may lead to accidental oversized positions
improvements: 增加点差过滤和交易时段过滤，避免在不利条件下开仓
增加多时间周期确认机制，例如更高周期趋势方向过滤，提高信号可靠性
优化止盈止损比例，考虑使用动态止损（如移动止损）来保护利润
improvements_en: Add spread filter and trading session filter to avoid opening positions under unfavorable conditions
Add multi-timeframe confirmation mechanism, such as higher timeframe trend direction filter, to improve signal reliability
Optimize take-profit/stop-loss ratio, consider using dynamic stop loss (e.g. trailing stop) to protect profits

risk_points: 缺乏点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能产生不利入场
依赖单一自定义指标，指标加载失败时EA无法运行
止损止盈参数为固定点数，未考虑市场波动率变化
无持仓检查逻辑，可能在已有同向持仓时重复开仓
risk_points_en: No spread filter, potentially entering at unfavorable prices during high spread conditions
Depends on a single custom indicator; EA cannot run if indicator fails to load
Fixed stop loss and take profit in points, does not account for market volatility changes
No position check logic, may repeatedly open positions in the same direction
